purpose: Separate authorization to execute the frozen paired language-model proxy from authorization to make architecture, long-context capability, or release claims.

required: the language-loss estimand, pairs, stopping rule, and control-only target lock are frozen
the active evaluation manifest, thresholds, prompt-change versioning, contamination rule, and missing-suite outcome are frozen before model output
the failed contaminated RULER v1 result is preserved and the v2 successor is frozen before model output
hardware, model export, cache behavior, data windows, and checkpoint storage are qualified
not_required: HELMET real-data prompt, tokenizer, judge, and contamination qualification
execution of external capability suites that require a trained candidate checkpoint
proxy_training.reason: The proxy produces the checkpoints needed for later evaluation and supports only a paired base-language whole-architecture screen. Frozen unavailable suites remain mandatory failed release gates rather than disappearing from the evidence standard.

release_and_capability_claims.rule: Every required suite must be implemented, qualified, executed, and passing at the claimed effective length; a suite that cannot run is a failed release gate, not an omitted metric.

forbidden_inferences: component attribution to KDA, NoPE, GQA, or mixer ratio

target_lock.after: all three complete dense-control result records
target_lock.before: creating or inspecting any candidate result record
target_lock.command: uv run --extra cpu python -m scripts.paper_baseline_analyze lock-target research/paper-1/baseline_analysis.json results/Speck-Paper1/runs/Speck-Paper1-Baselines-131M-pair-0-seed-42-order-0-dense_global_param_match.json results/Speck-Paper1/runs/Speck-Paper1-Baselines-131M-pair-1-seed-43-order-536870912-dense_global_param_match.json results/Speck-Paper1/runs/Speck-Paper1-Baselines-131M-pair-2-seed-44-order-1073741824-dense_global_param_match.json --output results/Speck-Paper1/baseline-time-to-quality-target.json

execution.tracking_reason: Retain immutable local intermediate metrics without making training availability depend on an external logging service.
execution.recovery: Resume the same frozen cell from its latest valid checkpoint; if it cannot be resumed, retain the failed attempt, document root cause, and preregister any rerun.

host.reason: Do not overlap the memory-heavy HELMET Xet transfer with compilation and full-model training on this 32 GiB host.
